race.comment: HAPPY DAD (1) ran below best last time finishing fourth (29.89) over 515m at Sandown from Box 7. Is yet to miss the placings from this draw, including two wins, from four starts. Better than last start and worth following up. ASTON SUMMIT (5) produced a sharp 25.34 when placed over 450m at Shepparton last start in a Grade 4/5. Expected to feature again. LEKTRA SKIP (3) has mixed form recently, finishing fifth (35.03) in a Grade 5 at Sandown latest but did run well two back when in the frame. Expected to bounce back to best. MEPUNGA LILLY (6) placed in slick time last start - worth some thought.
